requirements: Predicted node must represent the same independently teachable/assessable unit.
Aliases and harmless wording differences are accepted.
Over-broad nodes that collapse multiple Gold nodes should be reported as under-splitting.
Overly fine fragments without independent teaching/mastery value should be reported as over-splitting.

relationMatching.prerequisiteStrength: Evaluate hard/soft separately when prediction exposes strength; do not fail an otherwise correct edge solely because strength is unavailable in the first implementation.
relationMatching.cyclePolicy: Any prerequisite cycle is an invariant failure.

required: no curriculum container emitted as KnowledgeNode
curriculum order not silently persisted as KnowledgeRelation

aggregateScore: Do not create a single aggregate score in Gold v0.1.
